listing.description: Enter into your own private retreat in the Oakland Hills' Thornhill neighborhood. Anchored by an oversized stone fireplace, the light-filled great room sets the tone for elegant leisure, with living areas flowing gracefully from room to room. An abundance of windows welcome in the verdant surroundings throughout the main floor, with a welcoming multi-level deck off the dining area that beckons for morning coffee or impromptu al fresco gatherings. The wonderfully-updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar next to a picture-perfect sitting room, while a secluded loft nook overlooks most of the main floor. Direct garage access from this level is an added convenience. Finally, a bedroom with direct exterior access rounds out the main floor's offerings. Downstairs, find an enviable primary suite with updated bath, as well as two more bedrooms, laundry and a remodeled full bath, as well as direct access to the back deck structure. On the lowest level, accessible from the deck, find your bliss with a lounge room, half-bath, and dry sauna room. Perfection.

view.note: Forest/eucalyptus immersion only — no bay, city, or ridge vistas in any of 47 photos (p_02, p_08, p_38, p_47); MLS honestly lists View: Forest.

natural_light.note: Vaulted great room with skylights + sliders (p_02, p_11, p_12), sun patches in kitchen/dining (p_07, p_13), bright primary (p_28); main-floor bedroom relies on high windows (p_20) and lowest level is end-lit only (p_43).

character.note: 1978 contemporary with post-and-beam touches: exposed dark beams, vaulted ceilings, floor-to-ceiling stacked-stone fireplace (p_04, p_11); not pedigree MCM but not generic.

kitchen.note: Updated white shaker + quartz-look counters + subway tile, Samsung stainless, breakfast bar, corner windows over sink (p_13-p_16); mid-tier appliances, clean flip-grade+ execution.

privacy.note: Canyon/deck side is genuinely secluded in eucalyptus (p_38, p_47); street side has neighbor bridge-driveway in window view (p_18, p_25), upslope house ~40-60 ft (p_10), lattice privacy screen on lower deck (p_38).

layout_flow.note: Great room/kitchen/dining/deck flow well (p_06, p_17); but 3+ levels means vertical living — bedroom on main, 3 below, lounge/sauna at bottom (p_22, p_25); loft nook overlooks it all (p_24).

primary_suite.note: Downstairs suite with big corner windows to trees (p_28), double-vanity bath, walk-in rain shower (p_31, p_32); exterior deck stair passes one window (p_29).

outdoor_space.note: Multi-level wood decks with forest immersion, dining space + privacy screen (p_38-p_40), shaded lower patio (p_41); all wood in fire country, no flat yard.

condition.note: Turnkey cohesive renovation — kitchen, all baths, LVP floors, fixtures (p_15, p_31, p_35, p_45); 1978 bones, weathering deck furniture/boards (p_40), short sale implies as-is.

lot_usability.note: 0.37 AC but steep downslope — usable area is the deck structure; rest is eucalyptus slope requiring fuel management (p_40, p_47).

verdict: This house IS the trade: a big, turnkey, flexible 4-bed tree-house at a distressed short-sale price ($449/sf in a $520+/sf micro-market) in exchange for Very High fire-zone exposure with eucalyptus touching the decks, vertical hillside living, and short-sale process risk. Views are forest immersion, not bay or city — if 'views' means water, this isn't the house; if it means waking up inside a green canyon, it delivers. For a solo technical buyer the 4 real bedrooms + loft office nook + lounge + sauna offer office/guest/gym flexibility almost nothing else at this price does — but insurance availability and lender-approval timeline are the gating items, not the house itself.

crosschecks.result: Verified honest. Sauna (p_46), multi-level deck (p_38-p_42), stone fireplace (p_04), breakfast bar (p_13), garage direct access (p_01), 'light-filled' (p_02-p_07), 'verdant surroundings' = forest, matching MLS View: Forest. Zero drone shots — no implied bay views. Rare honest listing.

Marginal flag: Census (37.84640, -122.21060) vs page (37.84654, -122.21005) = 165 ft apart, just over the 150 ft threshold — hillside parcel centroid vs address interpolation; immaterial for hazard/context purposes.

975.8 ft in Thornhill (Montclair hills, 94611), near Skyline ridge. Same-street comp: 7094 Pinehaven (saved bundle, 3.4/5) at $795K / $520/sf — this house is bigger (2,336 vs 1,530 sf) and $71/sf cheaper, i.e. short-sale discount is real.
Deck side inferred W-SW: afternoon sun flare through eucalyptus in p_38-p_40, bright PM-style deck light; street side E-NE. Consistent with downhill-side lot on Pinehaven. Labeled inference.

Very High FHSZ (presumptive) — 94611 inside 1991 Oakland firestorm footprint; insurance availability flag raised per Oakland hills policy. Eucalyptus at structure + wood decks/siding raise mitigation burden.
All verifiable claims confirmed in photos; no drone/village amenity shots to fact-check (gallery is 100% interior + on-property).

4 real bedrooms, all with closets: primary (p_28-p_30), deck-slider bedroom (p_36), bedroom 3 (p_33), main-floor bedroom with exterior door (p_20-p_21).
